labels.label: T-abs-two-piece-hoist/two-piece
labels.notes: A hoist, no paper label. The twelve declarations (TwoPiece, twoPieceRel, TwoPiece.symm, rel_trans, le_top_iff, le_of_le_top, mem_of_le_top, exists_mid, diamond_top_eq, isCausal, isCauchySurface, and the witness timelikeLine_twoPiece) are byte-identical to HEAD 70265e2a: Ppcm HEAD lines 215-401 equal TwoPiece.lean 77-263, and HEAD 1306-1328 equal TwoPiece.lean 269-291, checked by list equality in Python. The scope lines are the same as Ppcm's (namespace Causal; open Set Topology Filter Function TopologicalSpace; universe u; namespace Causality). At HEAD the section had no outer `variable` in scope, because Crossing and CauchySide close their own sections. My own constant comparison does not reuse the closer's records. I elaborated a copy of `git show HEAD:` Ppcm with a dump appended, and dumped the current environment through `import Causal.CBG.Ppcm`. The same 26 TwoPiece/twoPieceRel/timelikeLine_twoPiece* constants exist in both. Exactly the 23 in REPORT's moved list are now in module Causal.TwoPiece. Each has the same kind, universe parameters, type hash, value hash, binder telescope (binder info and binder-type hash, macro scopes erased), docstring hash, reducibility and protected flag. The other three (TwoPiece.globallyHyperbolic, TwoPiece.isCompact_diamond_mixed, timelikeLine_twoPiece_globallyHyperbolic) are still in Causal.CBG.Ppcm. I also hashed every constant of Ppcm and TwoPiece now (120) against every constant of HEAD's Ppcm (120), with private names normalised. Types and values are identical, so the added import changed no remaining Ppcm proof term. The probe's 23 recorded hashes match my HEAD re-elaboration (0 mismatches). No label is marked: the ledger's mark pattern **`…`** finds nothing in the first 4000 characters.

build.notes: `taskset -c 0-11 lake env lean -DwarningAsError=true` on Causal/TwoPiece.lean and on Causal/CBG/Ppcm.lean: exit 0, no output. A mutation run on a copy (one `Or.inl` changed to `Or.inr` in rel_trans) fails with a type mismatch, so these runs really elaborate. In the code (ladder._code, comments blanked), sorry, admit, axiom and native_decide each count 0 in both files; the only textual `sorry` is the docstring line 'no `sorry` in this file'. I reran the closer's Probe.lean under -DwarningAsError=true: exit 0, '23 moved constants … 9 constants still in Causal.CBG.Ppcm'. Its #print axioms output matches axioms.txt line for line: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] everywhere, and [propext, Quot.sound] for twoPieceRel. I did not run `lake build`. `lake build --no-build` on Causal.TwoPiece, Causal.CBG.Ppcm and the twelve downstream modules reports 'All targets up-to-date (8791 jobs)', so the closer's green oleans match the current sources. Every downstream olean is newer than the last edit to TwoPiece.lean.

checks.docstrings: Pass. Ppcm's 'What is proved', Witnesses and SCOPE say that TwoPiece, its lemmas and timelikeLine_twoPiece are in Causal.TwoPiece and moved there byte for byte. The new module's docstring follows kb/0006: title, cited unmarked labels, a quote block, Hypothesis checklist, SCOPE (disclosed), Provenance. I checked the Sbierski quote against papers/sbierski-mghd/legacy/labeled/Maximal_GHD2.tex. The theorem label is at :411. The quoted sentences are at :767 and :769, verbatim apart from the transcription of LaTeX into Unicode and the elisions […]. 'p. 21' agrees with Ppcm's existing citation. ETT.tex:1994 is \label{prop:ppcm_Cauchy}, and ETT.tex:2324 reads '$\ppcm$ is Hausdorff, and it is a singular flat spacetime.' The checklist and SCOPE are accurate against the statements: isCauchySurface takes [T2Space P], hcaus, hSsub, hSA, hSB and hac, and every ⚠ row names an extra or replaced hypothesis. ManyPiece is in Causal.CBG.Maximal (:128), as SCOPE says. AbsolutelyMinimalOn (Generated.lean:239), IsCauchySurfaceOn (Cauchy.lean:73) and timelikeLine (Lines.lean:78) are where the docstring says, all inside CurveComponents' closure.
checks.witness_reading: Consistent with the evidence, which says the witness 'moves with the section if it uses nothing of PieceChart; the closer says which'. timelikeLine_twoPiece compiles in a module whose only import is Causal.CurveComponents, so it uses nothing of PieceChart, Crossing or CauchySide. The REPORT says which, and why the other two witnesses stay. Its docstring names isCompact_diamond_mixed, which stays in Ppcm. That is a prose mention of a downstream lemma, not a reference anything resolves, and it builds under warningAsError. Byte-for-byte forbids editing it, the REPORT discloses it, and the new module's SCOPE says isCompact_diamond_mixed stays in Causal.CBG.Ppcm. I accept it.

The only TwoPiece name in the certificates is Causal.Causality.TwoPiece.globallyHyperbolic (sbierski-mghd curation.toml:92, ledger.json:306), and it is not moved. Three rows list Causal/CBG/Ppcm.lean in extra_lean_files: sbierski-mghd curation.toml:93 (mghdthm:CommonExtension), ett :1139 (rem:CBG_analytique) and ett :1215 (prop:ppcm_Cauchy). In tools/ledger.py, extra_lean_files only adds to a row's lean_files. lean_files serves three things: the check 'declaration … not found in its listed files' (decl_line over lean_files), the display, and lean_scope_blocks, which applies only when no scope note is curated. Badge closure comes from the declarations, not the files, and no other tool reads lean_files. None of the three rows' decls is moved, so `ledger.py check` stays correct without Causal/TwoPiece.lean. Adding it would be cosmetic.
